skills.name: ddev
skills.description: DDev personal cross-repository development harness workflow. Use when the user explicitly invokes DDev or ddev, or when project instructions opt into DDev as the default development workflow. Coordinates global ~/.deweyou/dev state and product, UI, coding, delivery, and memory skills under one lifecycle owner.
skills.chineseDescription: 面向个人跨仓库开发的 DDev 生命周期工作流。

skills.name: problem-framing
skills.description: Problem framing workflow for Grilling, brainstorming, tradeoff critique, and recommendation. Use when the user asks to brainstorm, explore options, clarify requirements, think through a product/design/technical direction before implementation, or when another workflow needs a compact problem frame before building.
skills.chineseDescription: 用于追问、发散、权衡批判和形成建议的问题定义工作流。

skills.name: product-design
skills.description: Product design workflow for personal products. Use when the user asks whether to build an idea or feature, how to shape the next version, how similar products solve a problem, or how to turn product thinking into a buildable decision without enterprise process theater.
skills.chineseDescription: 面向个人软件的产品范围、版本规划和产品判断工作流。

skills.name: ui-design
skills.description: UX/UI design and prototype workflow for research, flow design, visual style, implementation, review, and AI design prompts. Use for DDev UI requirement design that needs a prototype, and for web, mobile/H5, native apps, HarmonyOS, mini programs, macOS, dashboards, tools, component libraries, onboarding, settings, empty states, UX references, or explicit UI/UX/style requests.
skills.chineseDescription: 覆盖 UX、视觉设计、原型、实现与现场验证的 UI 工作流。

skills.name: spec-driven-coding
skills.description: DDev-native coding workflow for features, behavior changes, debugging, TDD, and verification. Use when starting or continuing implementation work, requirement alignment, behavior-impacting refactors, ambiguous coding tasks, or bugfixes that need reproduction, tests, focused repair, and evidence.
skills.chineseDescription: DDev 原生的需求对齐、实现和验证编码工作流。

skills.name: git-delivery
skills.description: Branch-aware git delivery workflow. Use before editing new coding or asset tasks to check branch, dirty work, and base sync; use when the user asks to commit, submit, push, open a PR, ship work, resolve base conflicts, or follow PR CI, while protecting unrelated work.
skills.chineseDescription: 保护工作区边界的分支感知 Git 交付工作流。

skills.name: repo-memory
skills.description: Repository memory workflow for durable project knowledge. Use before commits or PRs, after meaningful code or workflow changes, when initializing or updating AGENTS.md/docs/DESIGN.md/CLAUDE.md, or when local skills, design contracts, and repo conventions may need knowledge updates.
skills.chineseDescription: 为仓库沉淀难以从代码恢复的长期知识。

skills.name: product-notes
skills.description: Product notes workflow for turning product thinking into durable notes. Use when the user wants to capture ideas, positioning, iteration plans, decisions, insights, competitor observations, release reviews, or discussion outcomes in a custom product notes workspace.
skills.chineseDescription: 将讨论和研究整理为可持续维护的产品笔记。

skills.name: skill-eval
skills.description: Skill evaluation workflow. Use only when the user explicitly asks to generate or complete skill eval cases, run a skill eval suite, test skill routing, or evaluate whether prompts trigger the right skill.
skills.chineseDescription: 通过可评分用例评估 Skill 的触发和工作流行为。

rules.name: collaboration-defaults
rules.description: Default agent collaboration behavior for language, ambiguity, context, task order, parallel work, evidence, safety, and handoff.
rules.chineseDescription: 关于语言、歧义、上下文、任务顺序、并行、证据、安全和交接的默认协作行为。

rules.name: code-style
rules.description: Code expression preferences for naming, functions, comments, errors, and tests.
rules.chineseDescription: 关于命名、函数、注释、错误和测试的代码表达偏好。

rules.name: engineering-principles
rules.description: Design preferences for module boundaries, abstraction, dependencies, state, and easy-to-delete code.
rules.chineseDescription: 关于模块边界、抽象、依赖、状态和易删除代码的工程设计偏好。

rules.name: ddev-local-state
rules.description: Ownership, visibility, cleanup, and commit boundaries for global DDev local state under ~/.deweyou/dev.
rules.chineseDescription: 关于 ~/.deweyou/dev 下全局 DDev 本地状态的所有权、可见性、清理和提交边界。

rules.name: verification-evidence
rules.description: Evidence expectations for completion claims, skipped checks, live UI/runtime proof, and verification gaps.
rules.chineseDescription: 关于完成结论、跳过检查、现场 UI 或 runtime 证明以及验证缺口的证据要求。

rules.name: loop-boundaries
rules.description: Bound implementation, debugging, verification, and CI repair loops so agents know when to continue, stop, or ask.
rules.chineseDescription: 为实现、调试、验证和 CI 修复循环设置边界，明确何时继续、停止或询问。

designs.name: dewey-interface
designs.description: Restrained, typographic, component-driven interface style for Dewey's personal products.
designs.chineseDescription: 克制、重排版、组件驱动的个人产品界面风格。
